    simp only [he, if_pos hneg]
    rw [norm_mul, norm_phiG_neg hW hGc hGd hG2]

    (q : XiZeroCopy) :

  have hs : 1 + sharedCopyWeight hW q ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (by
